title_en: Supreme People's Court's Reply on Whether the People's Court Shall Accept Applications for Recognition of Civil Mediation Documents Issued by Relevant Courts in the Taiwan Region or Mediation Agreements Issued or Confirmed by Relevant Institutions

articles.content_en:
Sichuan Higher People's Court:
Your request regarding whether a People's Court shall accept a party's application for recognition of a civil mediation document issued by a relevant court in the Taiwan region or a mediation agreement issued or confirmed by a relevant institution has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
A civil mediation document issued by a relevant court in the Taiwan region is an agreement reached by the parties under the auspices of the court and shall be deemed to have the same effect as a civil judgment of the court. Where a party applies to the People's Court for recognition, the People's Court shall accept the application by analogy with the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Recognition of Civil Judgments Rendered by the Courts in the Taiwan Region. However, where a party applies to the People's Court for recognition of a mediation agreement issued or confirmed by a relevant institution in the Taiwan region (including a civil mediation institution), the People's Court shall not accept the application.
This is our reply.
April 27, 1999
